metaTitle: Beach Tent vs Canopy vs Umbrella
description: Compare beach tents, canopies and umbrellas on shade, UV, wind, sand anchoring, privacy and price to pick the right shelter for your beach day.
directAnswer: Beach tents give the most sun and wind protection and a place to change, canopies shade the most floor area for groups, and umbrellas are lightest but offer the least coverage. Anchor any of them well in sand.
